title: Cleverbridge discloses data breach involving payment card data
excerpt: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge is notifying customers that a security breach resulted in the theft of credit card numbers and CVV codes.
body_html:
E-commerce platform Cleverbridge has issued warnings to customers regarding a security breach that exposed sensitive payment card information. According to the company, unauthorized hackers managed to compromise its systems and steal customer details.

The stolen data includes critical financial information such as credit card numbers and CVV security codes. Cleverbridge is alerting affected individuals about the incident so they can take necessary precautions regarding their payment accounts.
